title: Drag reorder: disarm the drag when the button is released outside the row (Fable review F2)
description: Fable review F2. src/components/useDragReorder.ts arms DragController.pending on pointerdown without capturing the pointer; capture happens only after the 5 px threshold, and onPointerUp is bound to the row, so a release elsewhere never clears pending. Afterwards the pointer crossing that row with no button down lifts the row, shifts its siblings and shows the drop line until Escape or a click; a click that moves 5 px reorders and saves. Fix: capture on pointerdown (or listen for window pointerup/pointercancel while armed) and ignore moves with e.buttons === 0. Fail-first: add a Playwright case to tests/drag-reorder.spec.ts that presses a manuscript row, moves sideways into the editor at the same y, releases, moves back over the row 20 px lower, and expects no [data-drag-state] (the Fable probe P2 in node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui3-fable-review/probe/probe.spec.mjs does exactly this and currently finds 1 lifted row). Keep the press-is-a-click rule and the arrows.

review.note: Reviewed: window capture pointerup/pointercancel one-shot disarm removes itself (no leak; stale ones self-remove on next release), buttons===0 guard in controller.move plus snap cancel, Escape/click-swallow/arrows untouched. Fail-first logs present (unit 2 failed pre, pw-pre 1 failed), pass logs newer than sources; reran vitest src/components 30/30.

log.note: Fixed F2. dragReorder.ts: DragController.move(y, buttons=1) discards the press when buttons===0. useDragReorder.ts: onPointerDown registers a one-shot window capture-phase pointerup/pointercancel that cancels the controller if not yet captured; onPointerMove passes e.buttons and cancels a lifted snap when buttons===0. Arrows, Escape, click-not-drag unchanged. Tests: 2 new unit tests in dragReorder.test.ts, 1 new Playwright case in drag-reorder.spec.ts (press row, release in editor, hover back over row, expect no data-drag-state).
